transport: MeterBus RJ-11 only, via a Morningstar MSC MeterBus-to-Serial Converter to isolated RS-232 · Modbus RTU · 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits, no flow control · default server address 0x01
blocks: 0x0000 version · 0x0004 raw ADC rails · 0x0011 filtered ADC · 0x001A temperatures · 0x0021 charger status · 0x002E load status · 0xE000 EEPROM settings · coils from 0x0000
sharedMapEvidence: The Read Device Identification table in *ProStar PWM MODBUS Specification* v2.0 (MS-001838, 22 March 2017) lists all four product codes against this one map: "PS-PWM-15", "PS-PWM-15M", "PS-PWM-30", "PS-PWM-30M". The 15 A and 30 A units differ in rating only; the M suffix is the on-board meter.
gotchas: GENERATION RISK, and it is the important one on this entry. Modbus exists on ProStar Gen 3 only. The Gen 2 was replaced by the Gen 3 in January 2017, both are sold as 'PS-15' / 'PS-30', both have an RJ-11 MeterBus port, and the retailer listing does not say which is on the shelf. Two independent pieces of vendor eviden
Values are Float16, as on the ProStar MPPT.

This map is a subset of the ProStar MPPT map, not a copy of it — the addresses that both define agree (0x0021 charge_state, 0x0023 vb_f, 0x0024 vb_ref, 0x002E load_state, 0x0030 V_lvd, the coil block), but the PWM marks RESERVED where the MPPT has real registers: 0x0010 (charge current), 0x0015 (net battery current), 0
Because 0x0015 is RESERVED here, net battery current is only available from adc_ib_f_1m at 0x0019 — a 60-second filtered value. There is no fast battery-current reading on this controller.
MeterBus RJ-11 is the only port; an MSC adapter is mandatory.
unmappedReports: T_hs heatsink temperature (0x001A), Ahc_r / Ahc_t / Ahl_r / Ahl_t amp-hour counters and kWhc_r / kWhc_t (0x0026-0x002B, 0x0032-0x0035), vb_ref regulator reference voltage (0x0024), array_fault (0x0022), load_fault (0x002F) and alarm bitfields, V_lvd / V_lhvd live disconnect thresholds (0x0030/0x0031), Tb_lo_limit_100 / Tb_lo_limit_0 cold-battery foldback (0x002C/0x002D), state-of-charge — not reported
